missing_field_families: NOT_ESTABLISHED_UNTIL_FIXED_PRODUCER_PLAN; default-argument/type-call families require applicability proof, not automatic expansion of146 fields

required_effect_gaps.EXACT_MISSING_DECISION: For the ten configured/body fields bind exact source acquisition -> transforming operation -> effective principal -> reader result path, so raw secret-bearing values never reach the reader under an unproved adapter boundary.
required_effect_gaps.WHY_STATIC: Closed output codec/config policy specifies WHAT may leave, not which authority/path executes acquisition and transformation. This is missing static source-principal/operation plan, not missing future key/OID/binary value.
required_effect_gaps.MINIMUM_NEXT_ACTION: Provide a finite typed source projection/normalization plan with executing principals, exact field transformations and source/effect provenance. Keep existing output restrictions and no role/secret widening.

required_effect_gaps.EXACT_MISSING_DECISION: Bind all explicit and implicit parser/type/default/routine calls of the fixed producer to source-backed effects or prove those call families unreachable. A body hash alone is not a body-effect proof.
required_effect_gaps.WHY_STATIC: The finite source callable/operation set and effect construction rule must be fixed before an implementation can conform. No physical authentication selection or actual runtime catalog snapshot is demanded.
required_effect_gaps.MINIMUM_NEXT_ACTION: Derive the producer invocation/effect manifest from the typed source plan, preserve creator/default/owner/INHERIT/SET/ADMIN distinctions, and prove unsupported calls fail before effects. Do not assign ALLOW/DENY to a future boundary merely by intention.
